title: 第25章 叠浪剑诀第26章 摆摊
slug: 顶级悟性从修炼基础剑法开始
lines: 第二十五章叠浪剑诀
基础剑法，已经被他练至化境，达到返璞归真之境，已然无法再提升。
基础剑法虽强，辅以剑势，也能够让他越阶杀敌。
但是基础剑法毕竟仅有基础剑招，比起武技剑诀还是差了许多。
不断浏览着书架上的一个个格子，方羽足足看了数十部剑诀。
最后方羽的目光锁定第九个书架，最角落的那个格子上。
“叠浪剑诀。”
剑诀之名平平无奇，不似其他剑诀名字那么好听，那么有气势。
但是方羽不知道为何，看到这剑诀，第一眼就停下了脚步。
随后方羽开始看着剑诀的简介。
“叠浪剑诀，黄阶下品剑诀，锻体四重以上可修炼，剑仅一招，练至巅峰，一剑九叠，一剑就可将自身战力叠加九倍。但是对肉身经脉，要求很高，练之请谨慎，并且对天赋要求偏高，天赋一般，慎练。”
方羽看着这叠浪剑诀的简介，眼中骤然绽放出璀璨的光芒。
随后方羽想也不想，直接拿出身份令牌，将身份令牌放在那块青色玉简之上。
只见那青色玉简青光一闪，方羽手中的令牌也随之闪耀出一阵白光。
半晌之后，方羽见那玉简，再无动静，当下收回手来。
随后方羽握着身份令牌，将其放在眉心，气劲随之涌入身份令牌之内。
只见那身份令牌白光一闪，方羽的脑海中，瞬间浮现一个文字。
方羽看着这些文字，眼中不由露出精光，随后将身份令牌取下。
看着身份令牌，眼中露出了赞叹之色。
“不愧是超凡势力，这手段就不是一般势力能够比拟的。”
方羽低声自语道。
他方家在大夏皇朝之中，也算是大世家的存在，但是却没有这等手段，他也从未见过这等手段。
方羽摇了摇头，随后朝着阁外走去。
方羽刚到阁外，那中年男子就睁开了双眼，看着方羽中年男子眼中闪过一缕精光。
随后中年男子伸出手来，方羽会意，将那身份令牌递了过去。
中年男子接住方羽的身份令牌，查看了一番之后，不由惊讶的看了方羽一眼。
随后皱着眉头看着方羽开口说道。
“叠浪剑诀？你确定要修炼这门剑诀吗？你可知道，这门剑诀，就算是诸峰的核心弟子，都没有人能够练成，剑阁立阁这么多年，练成这部剑诀的一掌之数都不到，而且这门剑诀对修炼者要求很高，你若是达不到，练习之后，稍有不慎，轻者经脉断裂，重者走火入魔，小子，我现在给你个机会，进去换一门剑诀。”
方羽看着中年男子的神色，以及其说话的语气，当下心不由微微一沉，但是想到他说剑阁立阁这么多年，也算是有人成功炼成，当下方羽就想到了造化神碑。
有造化神碑，他根本不用担心悟性限制。
除此之外，他修炼了造化金身，有造化之气的存在，他根本不用担心，修炼之后，失败经脉受损。
当下方羽看着中年男子，笑着开口说道。
“多谢长老，不过不用了，我就修炼这门剑法，我也想看看这门令无数剑阁先辈为之叹息的剑诀，到底是什么成分，若是事不可为，我也不会强求，若是出了什么岔子，方羽自当自己负责。”

Chapter 25: The Overlapping Wave Sword Technique
The basic swordsmanship has been trained by him to the state of transformation, reaching the state of returning to nature, and it can no longer be improved.
Although his basic swordsmanship is strong, supplemented by his sword power, he can also kill enemies across levels.
But after all, basic swordsmanship only has basic sword moves, which are still much worse than martial arts sword techniques.
Continuously browsing through the shelves on the bookshelf, Fang Yu read dozens of sword techniques.
Finally, Fang Yu's eyes locked on the ninth bookshelf, the corner grid.
"Die Lang Sword Technique."
The name of Sword Jue is unremarkable, not as nice or impressive as other names of Sword Jue.
But Fang Yu didn't know why, but he stopped at the first sight of this sword technique.
Then Fang Yu started to look at the introduction of Sword Jue.
"Dielang Sword Technique, a low-grade Huang-level sword technique, can be practiced at the fourth level or above. The sword only needs one move. After practicing to the peak, one sword can stack nine times. One sword can superimpose one's own combat power nine times. However, the requirements for the physical meridians are very high. Please be careful when practicing. Also, the talent requirements are relatively high. The talent is average, so practice with caution."
Fang Yu looked at the introduction to the Duolang Sword Technique, and his eyes suddenly burst into bright light.
Then, without thinking, Fang Yu took out his identity token and placed it on the blue jade slip.
I saw the green jade slip flashing with blue light, and the token in Fang Yu's hand also shone with a burst of white light.
After a while, Fang Yu saw that there was no movement on the jade slip, so he immediately retracted his hand.
Then Fang Yu held the identity token and placed it between his eyebrows, and his energy flowed into the identity token.
The identity token flashed white, and a word instantly appeared in Fang Yu's mind.
Fang Yu couldn't help but shine as he looked at these words, and then took off his identity token.
Looking at the identity token, admiration appeared in his eyes.
"As expected of an extraordinary force, this method is not comparable to that of ordinary forces."
Fang Yu whispered to himself.
His Fang family was considered a big family in the Great Xia Dynasty, but they did not have such means, and he had never seen such means.
Fang Yu shook his head and then walked out of the pavilion.
As soon as Fang Yu arrived outside the pavilion, the middle-aged man opened his eyes and looked at Fang Yu with a glint in his eyes.
Then the middle-aged man stretched out his hand. Fang Yu understood and handed over the identity token.
The middle-aged man caught Fang Yu's identity token and after checking it, he couldn't help but look at Fang Yu in surprise.
Then he frowned and looked at Fang Yu and said.
"Dielang Sword Technique? Are you sure you want to practice this sword technique? Do you know that no one, even the core disciples of Zhufeng, can master this sword technique? After so many years of setting up the sword pavilion, it takes more than one palm to master this sword technique. No, and this sword art has very high requirements for practitioners. If you fail to meet it, if you are not careful after practicing, your meridians may be broken, or your meridians may go crazy. Boy, I will give you a chance now to change to another sword art. "
Fang Yu looked at the middle-aged man's expression and the tone of his words, and his heart sank slightly. But thinking that he said that someone had successfully made the sword pavilion for so many years, Fang Yu immediately thought of the creation monument.
With the Creation Monument, he doesn't have to worry about the limitations of his understanding.
In addition, he has cultivated the Golden Body of Creation and has the presence of the Qi of Creation. He does not have to worry about the failure of his meridians to be damaged after practicing.
Fang Yu looked at the middle-aged man and said with a smile.
"Thank you, elder, but no need. I will practice this sword technique. I also want to see what the ingredients are in this sword technique that has made countless sword pavilion ancestors sigh. If something cannot be done, I will not force it. If anything goes wrong, Fang Yu will be responsible for it himself."
